THREE LAYERS OF RESPONSIBILITY

Trust is a sequence.

ASSET→ENCRYPT→VAULT
Protect what’s stored.

AES-256-GCM encryption with a unique initialization vector for each entry protects credentials at rest.

01 / FULL-STACK · SECURITY

DataWill

A digital legacy, in the right hands.

How do you pass on digital assets without exposing them too early? I built an encrypted credential vault and an automated beneficiary handoff with a 72-hour challenge window.

THE ENGINEERING DECISION

A missed check-in starts a challenge window, not an immediate release. An emergency cancel PIN provides a way to stop the handoff.

47+REST API endpoints

Visit project ↗Source code ↗
Under the hood +

Unique initialization vectors per vault entry. Session authentication with JWT fallback, rate limiting, and input validation. A node-cron dead man’s switch includes an emergency cancel PIN; PDFKit and tokenized beneficiary access support credential delivery.

02 / APPLIED MACHINE LEARNING

Solar intelligence.

Predictive maintenance for solar farms.

I built a multimodal pipeline that combines six-class visual fault detection with ensemble regression to assess solar panel health.

THE ENGINEERING DECISION

I used two-phase transfer learning and class-weight correction for image classification, then combined XGBoost and LightGBM for regression.

BASELINE78%→AFTER TRANSFER LEARNING95%
+17pptest accuracy improvement
0.910ensemble R²
TensorFlowXGBoostLightGBMFastAPI
Inside the pipeline +

MobileNetV2 classifies six solar fault categories using 1,065+ labeled images. Two-phase transfer learning and class-weight correction raised accuracy from 78% to 95%. A rule-based decision engine combines CNN confidence scores with the multimodal pipeline.
